text:
Ruth: dropped tiny mock for compact capacity row: https://figma.link/compact-cap-row 12 ask: quick copy + a11y checks for min/max labels + peak action.
Mei: copy try: 'Min reserve' (short) and 'Max capacity' with subtext 'scales for peaks'. Avoid 'burst'.
Hector: a11y nit: tab order must be stepper -> SLO slider -> peak button. also add aria-live polite for cost updates.
Samir: billing phrasing: show both rate and billing unit: '+1 GPU  $0.60/hr (billed per GPU-minute)'. prefer dollars over %s.
Ruth: UI idea: when Min > Max show inline helper: 'Min cannot exceed Max' + action 'Set Max to Min' (focusable).
A11yBot: checklist: keyboard order, aria-live polite with 250ms debounce, visible focus ring, contrast >=4.5:1 for CTA, tooltips <140 chars.
Mei: +1 on 'Min reserve' label. Ruth: will update frame and post new link by EOD.
Samir: i'll draft the acceptance criteria for keyboard flow.
Hector: will run quick screen-reader pass tomorrow.
Ruth: thanks 680
